findings: APOB p.(Pro955Ser) variant reduces LDL receptor binding affinity by 44%
Significant difference in LDL internalization efficiency between healthy individuals and variant carriers (p<0.01)
Dose-dependent effect observed between heterozygous and homozygous p.(Pro955Ser) variants
rationale: The variant shows statistically significant reduction in LDL binding affinity (44%) with p<0.01, demonstrating a clear functional impact consistent with FH pathogenesis. The effect is dose-dependent (heterozygous vs homozygous) and shows comparable impact to known pathogenic variant p.(Arg3527Gln).
experimental_details: LDL internalization efficiency measured via fluorescence intensity after 30-min incubation at 37°C in hepatocytes. Biological replicates n=3. Compared against healthy controls and known pathogenic variant p.(Arg3527Gln).
p2_source_location: FH probands: 15% vs 3.4% in controls (OR=4.9, p=6.9×10⁻¹³) reported in Fig. 2/text
